reviewed_boundary_findings.interpretation: One near-exact same-type punctuation boundary miss is directly documented. Most other overlaps are embedded Disease/Symptom names inside long criterion statements, not proven simple truncation or same-name type errors.

source_contract_observation: Active ontology describes subtype_of only as 亚型; prompt says preserve directed relation but does not define subtype(child)->parent or give directional examples. No inversion is performed by render/parse.
limitations: Strict surface-overlap candidates are diagnostic string matches, not asserted synonyms and not rescored TP.
Gold remains teacher silver; fixed first20 subtype sample is not a clinical accuracy estimate.
Generation failure and missing names can overlap with long boundaries; categories are priority-ordered, not additive causal attribution.

fixed_train_subtype_sample.limitations: 12/20 come from a single source; no estimate of overall clinical accuracy or all 440 annotation consistency.

recommendations: No source/target flipping fix is justified: full compiler, rendering and parsing preserve original prepared directions.
A future versioned train-only prompt/ontology clarification can explicitly define subtype(child)->broader parent and contrast has_subtype, but do not change frozen labels or scores based on tune.

Criterion work should target statement-level entity granularity and complete qualified span copying; source-admission relaxation would not recover the 77 misses because all83 names are already supported.
Retain exact original denominator and separate complete-name type error from missing-name and generation-delivery failures; substring matches are not TP.
